acceptance.given: The plan compiler is authoring Acceptance assertions for independently observable obligations, including obligations that share an implementation owner.

oracle.expected: The compiled plan contains one distinct Acceptance assertion for each independently observable obligation, and no assertion merges two independently observable obligations solely because their implementation owner is shared.
forbidden: A single Acceptance assertion represents multiple independently observable obligations because they share an implementation owner.
The compiled plan omits an independently observable obligation's distinct assertion.
oracle.observable: The compiled Acceptance artifact's obligation-to-assertion mapping and assertion records, evaluated during plan compilation and validation.

acceptance.then: The compiler emits and validates a distinct assertion record for this obligation, preserving its independent observable boundary.
acceptance.when: During compilation and structural validation of the current execution plan, inspect the Acceptance artifact and its obligation-to-assertion mapping.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A compiler validation test supplies independently observable obligations that share an implementation owner and verifies that a merged Acceptance assertion is rejected or the missing distinct assertion is reported.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Plan compilation preserves one independent Acceptance assertion per independently observable obligation, even when implementation ownership is shared.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert only the compiler assertion-mapping validation change while preserving existing plan formats and independently authored Acceptance records.

slice_hint.state_transition: Uncompiled or merged-obligation Acceptance mappings become compiled artifacts with independently addressable assertions for each obligation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: V3 compiler validation passes only when every independently observable obligation has its own Acceptance assertion and rejects owner-based assertion merging.
